column2: ENGLISH

You cannot hold it in any longer. The power of Chaos running through your body is stronger than your will, and with a shriek your flesh twists and splits open. What crawls out of the ruin of you has no name and no mind, only hunger.
AAArglrluablhjggghhh!!

You honoured the gods in every deed and waited for their gifts. None came. Their gaze has passed over you, and only the voices remain, mocking and berating you through every sleepless night. The gods have cursed you and left you behind.
Nooorrrgh!!!
Your mind or body has been warped by a mutation, the work of the Dark Gods.
May [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName] have mercy on me.
The voices never stop now. Sometimes the world changes in the blink of an eye: friend turns to foe, night to day, and the walls breathe. Is anything at all real?
Blreagh!
Sometimes you think the whole world is a dream, and you are the dreamer. Those poor fools around you have no idea they are only figments of your mind...
Ah, idiots!
People look at you strangely these days, as if they were hiding something. When you ask them about it, they never give you a straight answer.
People are strange.

Mutation is the mark of Chaos, and the marks of Chaos must be rooted out with fire and sword. While you are here you watch the court closely, and one of [Root.Liege.GetTitledFirstName]'s courtiers is trying very hard to keep something hidden...
I will confront this abomination.

Curses! [From.GetTitledFirstName], the witch hunter at court, has been watching you, and now [From.GetSheHe] has seen what you have tried so hard to hide. The fires are already being talked about in the kitchens.
I will throw myself on my liege's mercy!
I must flee this court tonight!

[From.GetTitledFirstName] kneels before you, shaking. "My liege! It is true, my flesh has been twisted by Chaos, but I do not serve the Ruinous Powers, I swear it! I am a victim, not a cultist. Do not let the witch hunter burn me!"
Unclean abomination! Death by fire!
Very well, I shall show mercy. But see a surgeon at once!
I will not burn you, but nor will I let you roam free...

You come out of your chambers, but the changes in your body can no longer be hidden. The first servant who sees you screams and runs for the guards. They surround you, and despite your pleas, one of them strikes, and the others quickly follow.
Goodbye, cruel world...

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has been cut down by [From.GetHerHis] own guards after coming out of [From.GetHerHis] chambers horribly mutated. The whole realm gossips of nothing else. These are dark times indeed...
Dark times indeed.
Do not bother me with such news again.
